# Grammar diagnostics reference

<!-- Generated by pg_grammar::grammar_health::render_diagnostics_reference. Do not edit by hand: the diagnostics_reference_is_current test rewrites this file when it is stale. -->

Every diagnostic `pangloss grammar-health` can report, grouped by level. Why each level exists, and the report format, are in [grammar-diagnostics.md](grammar-diagnostics.md).

## Errors (28)

Known bad: a restriction is dropped, two items become indistinguishable, or a whole morpheme is lost. Any error makes `pangloss grammar-health` exit non-zero.

| Code | Name | Origin | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hc-duplicate-feature-bundle` | Duplicate segment features | check | In Grammar > Phonemes, assign distinct feature values to these phonemes. |
| `hc-stem-no-grammatical-category` | Stem has no category | check | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, open the entry and set Grammatical Info. > Category. |
| `hc-inflectional-affix-missing-template-slot` | Inflectional affix has no slot | check | In Grammar > Category Edit > the category's Affix Templates, assign the affix to a template slot. |
| `hc-unclassified-affix` | Affix is unclassified | check | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, set the affix's Grammatical Info. to an inflectional or derivational affix. |
| `hc-partial-reason-unspecified` | Partial reason is unknown | check | In Grammar > Category Edit > the category's Affix Templates, check the affix's category and template slot assignments. |
| `fwdata.no-usable-allomorphs` | No usable allomorphs | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, add or correct an allomorph for the named lexical entry. |
| `grammar.phoneme.nfd-collision` | Phoneme representation collision | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, change the named phoneme's representation so it is unique. |
| `grammar.phoneme.feature-unresolved` | Unresolved phoneme feature value | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, correct the named phoneme's phonological feature values. |
| `grammar.phoneme.complex-feature-unsupported` | Unsupported phoneme feature value | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, replace the named phoneme's complex value with a supported feature value. |
| `grammar.boundary.nfd-collision` | Boundary representation collision | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, change the named boundary marker's representation so it is unique. |
| `grammar.natclass.feature-constraint-unresolved` | Unresolved natural class feature | import | In Grammar > Natural Classes, correct the named natural class's phonological feature constraints. |
| `grammar.natclass.complex-feature-unsupported` | Unsupported natural class feature | import | In Grammar > Natural Classes, replace the named natural class's complex feature with supported constraints. |
| `grammar.compound-rule.side-pos-unresolved` | Unresolved compound category | import | In Grammar > Compound Rules, assign a valid part of speech to the named compound rule side. |
| `grammar.compound-rule.side-exception-feature-unresolved` | Unresolved compound exception feature | import | In Grammar > Compound Rules, correct the named compound rule's exception feature. |
| `grammar.msa.no-allomorphs` | No usable entry allomorphs | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, add or correct an allomorph for the named lexical entry. |
| `grammar.msa.no-rule-form-allomorphs` | Analysis has no usable affix form | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, add a usable affix allomorph to the named analysis. |
| `grammar.msa.exception-feature-unresolved` | Unresolved analysis exception feature | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, correct the named analysis's exception features. |
| `grammar.msa.inflection-class-unresolved` | Unresolved analysis inflection class | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, assign a valid inflection class to the named analysis. |
| `grammar.msa.stem-name-unresolved` | Unresolved analysis stem name | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, assign a valid stem name to the named analysis. |
| `grammar.msa.lex-entry-infl-type-unresolved` | Unresolved entry inflection type | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, assign a valid entry inflection type to the named analysis; in Lists > Variant Types, add a missing type. |
| `grammar.allomorph.inflection-class-unresolved` | Unresolved allomorph inflection class | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, assign a valid inflection class to the named allomorph. |
| `grammar.circumfix.missing-half` | Circumfix is missing a half | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, add a prefix or suffix half to the named circumfix entry. |
| `grammar.environment.unresolved` | Unresolved phonological environment | import | In Grammar > Environments, add the missing environment; in Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, correct its reference on the named allomorph. |
| `grammar.environment.invalid` | Invalid phonological environment | import | In Grammar > Environments, correct the expression for phonological environment '_name_'. |
| `grammar.rule.feature-constraint-unresolved` | Unresolved rule feature constraint | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, correct the named rule's feature constraint. |
| `grammar.rule.feature-constraint-phon-feature-unresolved` | Unresolved phonological feature constraint | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, correct the named constraint's phonological feature reference. |
| `grammar.rule.rule-feature-unresolved` | Unresolved phonological rule feature | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, correct the named rule's feature reference. |
| `migration.inferred-segment-with-feature-rule` | Character is not listed as a phoneme | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, add the named character as a phoneme before assigning its feature values. |

## Warnings (55)

Something in FieldWorks should change, but the grammar still behaves as authored or only loses one alternative.

| Code | Name | Origin | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hc-undeclared-segment` | Missing segment definition | check | Depends on the item that uses the phoneme; the report names the FieldWorks tool. |
| `fwdata.dangling-reference` | Missing FieldWorks reference | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, restore or remove the named item's missing reference. |
| `fwdata.unexpected-class` | Unexpected FieldWorks item | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named item's class and references. |
| `fwdata.missing-required-field` | Missing required FieldWorks field | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, complete the named item's required field. |
| `fwdata.missing-lang-project` | Missing language project | import | In File > Restore a Project..., restore a valid FieldWorks project backup. |
| `fwdata.empty-representation` | Empty item representation | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, add a representation to the named phoneme or boundary marker. |
| `fwdata.unrecognized-enum-value` | Unrecognized FieldWorks value | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, replace the named item's value with one offered by FieldWorks. |
| `fwdata.metathesis-approximation` | Metathesis rule approximation | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, review the named metathesis rule's structural description. |
| `fwdata.stale-adhoc-prohibition` | Stale ad hoc prohibition | import | In Grammar > Ad hoc Rules, update the named prohibition's affix reference or remove it. |
| `fwdata.unsupported-morph-type` | Unsupported morph type | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, choose a supported morph type for the named allomorph. |
| `fwdata.unknown-morph-type-guid` | Unknown morph type reference | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, assign a morph type that exists in the project to the named allomorph. |
| `fwdata.reference-not-in-scope` | Reference outside item scope | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, move the named reference into the correct FieldWorks list. |
| `fwdata.invalid-parser-parameter` | Invalid parser setting | import | In Words > Edit Parser Parameters..., correct the named parser setting. |
| `invalid-source.active-parser` | Unsupported active parser | import | In Words > Edit Parser Parameters..., select a supported parser. |
| `invalid-source.duplicate-guid` | Duplicate FieldWorks GUID | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, resolve the duplicate identity for the named item. |
| `invalid-source.missing-guid` | Missing FieldWorks GUID | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, save the named item in FieldWorks so it has a stable identity. |
| `fwdata.writing-system-store-unreadable` | Writing system data unavailable | import | In Tools > Configure > Set up Vernacular Writing Systems... and Tools > Configure > Set up Analysis Writing Systems..., check the project's writing system data. |
| `snapshot.dangling-reference` | Missing snapshot reference | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, restore or remove the named item's missing reference. |
| `snapshot.feature-structure-unresolved` | Unresolved feature structure | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit for lexical features or Grammar > Phonological Features for phonological features, correct the named item's feature values. |
| `snapshot.rule-feature-unresolved` | Unresolved rule feature structure | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, correct the named rule's feature structure. |
| `snapshot.reference-out-of-scope` | Snapshot reference out of scope | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, move the named reference into the FieldWorks list that owns it. |
| `grammar.phoneme.no-representation` | Phoneme has no representation | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, add a grapheme representation to the named phoneme. |
| `grammar.boundary.no-representation` | Boundary marker has no representation | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, add a representation to the named boundary marker. |
| `grammar.boundary.morph-marker-unresolved` | Unresolved morpheme boundary | import | In Words > Edit Parser Parameters..., assign a declared boundary marker as the morpheme boundary. |
| `grammar.natclass.segments-member-unresolved` | Unresolved natural class member | import | In Grammar > Natural Classes, add a valid phoneme to the named natural class or remove the missing member. |
| `grammar.feature.phon-complex-unsupported` | Unsupported complex feature | import | In Grammar > Phonological Features, replace the named complex feature with a supported closed feature. |
| `grammar.stem-name.build-failed` | Stem name could not be loaded | import | In Grammar > Category Edit, check the named stem name's part of speech and features. |
| `grammar.stem-name.empty-regions` | Stem name has no regions | import | In Grammar > Category Edit, add a phonological region to the named stem name. |
| `grammar.compound-rule.build-failed` | Compound rule could not be loaded | import | In Grammar > Compound Rules, check the named compound rule's constituent categories. |
| `grammar.msa.build-failed` | Grammatical analysis could not be loaded | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named analysis's part of speech and features. |
| `grammar.variant.component-unresolved` | Unresolved variant component | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, correct the named variant entry's component reference. |
| `grammar.allomorph.unsegmentable` | Allomorph could not be segmented | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the spelling and phonological environments for allomorph '_name_'. |
| `grammar.allomorph.morph-type-unsupported` | Unsupported allomorph morph type | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, choose a supported morph type for the named allomorph. |
| `grammar.allomorph.not-a-rule-form` | Affix allomorph has no form | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, add a non-empty form to the named affix allomorph. |
| `grammar.allomorph.reduplication-unsupported` | Unsupported reduplication form | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, replace the named allomorph's bracket pattern with a supported form. |
| `grammar.allomorph.process-build-failed` | Affix process could not be loaded | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named allomorph's input and output mappings. |
| `grammar.allomorph.feature-build-failed` | Allomorph features could not be loaded | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named allomorph's morphosyntactic features. |
| `grammar.allomorph.environment-build-failed` | Allomorph environment could not be loaded | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, correct the named allomorph's phonological environment. |
| `grammar.circumfix.environment-combination-skipped` | Circumfix environment was skipped | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, correct the environment on the named circumfix half. |
| `grammar.template.slot-unresolved` | Affix template slot is unresolved | import | In Grammar > Category Edit > the category's Affix Templates, correct the named template's reference to its slot. |
| `grammar.template.slot-no-rules` | Affix template slot has no rules | import | In Grammar > Category Edit > the category's Affix Templates, add a loaded inflectional affix to the named slot or remove the empty slot. |
| `grammar.template.no-slots` | Empty affix template | import | In Grammar > Category Edit > the category's Affix Templates, add a slot containing an inflectional affix or remove the named empty template. |
| `grammar.template.build-failed` | Affix template could not be loaded | import | In Grammar > Category Edit > the category's Affix Templates, check the named template's slots and inflectional affixes. |
| `grammar.null-affix.mpr-unresolved` | Unresolved null-affix restriction | import | In Lists > Variant Types, correct the named entry inflection type's morphophonological restriction. |
| `grammar.null-affix.syn-fs-failed` | Null-affix features could not be loaded | import | In Lists > Variant Types, check the named entry inflection type's feature values. |
| `grammar.null-affix.segment-failed` | Null-affix form could not be segmented | import | In Lists > Variant Types, check the named entry inflection type's form and phoneme inventory. |
| `grammar.rule.metathesis-unsupported` | Unsupported metathesis rule | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, review the named metathesis rule's feature structure. |
| `grammar.rule.build-failed` | Phonological rule could not be loaded | import | In Grammar > Phonological Rules, check the named rule's structural description and change. |
| `grammar.strata.custom-unsupported` | Unsupported custom strata | import | In Words > Edit Parser Parameters..., review the project's parser strata settings. |
| `grammar.adhoc-prohibition.unresolved` | Unresolved ad hoc prohibition | import | In Grammar > Ad hoc Rules, correct the named prohibition's references to its forms. |
| `conversion.source-provenance-unknown` | Source item could not be identified | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named item's FieldWorks identity and references. |
| `conversion.unsegmentable-form` | Allomorph form cannot be segmented | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named allomorph's spelling and the project's phoneme inventory. |
| `substrate.classification-ambiguous` | Allomorph character is ambiguous | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, decide whether the named allomorph's character is a phoneme or boundary marker. |
| `conversion.unsupported-construct` | Unsupported FieldWorks construct | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, replace the named construct with a supported FieldWorks form. |
| `substrate.position-unmapped` | Allomorph character position is unmapped | import | In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check the named allomorph's character sequence against the project's phonemes and boundary markers. |

## Info (5)

Something was left out on purpose; nothing to fix.

| Code | Name | Origin | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fwdata.only-first-used` | Only first list item is used | import | In Grammar > Phonemes, check the project's phoneme sets. |
| `grammar.allomorph.morph-type-unsupported-as-rule-form` | Loaded through its separate parts | import | Nothing to fix. |
| `grammar.mrule.unreachable-compacted` | Affix is never used | import | Nothing to fix. |
| `grammar.cooccurrence.target-unreachable` | Ad hoc rule is never used | import | Nothing to fix. |
| `grammar.natclass.unreferenced-compacted` | Unused natural class | import | Nothing to fix. |
